configurations.//: The PWA cannot be verified against `dev`. The service worker refuses to register outside production (components/pwa.tsx), and install criteria need the real built output. Run `npm --prefix site run build` first, then start this. localhost counts as a secure context, so Chrome evaluates installability exactly as it would on HTTPS. What this does NOT reproduce is site/vercel.json — `next start` applies no headers, so the CSP's worker-src has to be checked on the deployed site.
configurations.name: site-prod
configurations.//autoPort: `next start` takes its port from PORT, and nothing here needs 3000 specifically — no OAuth callback, no webhook. The manifest's start_url is relative, so installability is unaffected by which port it lands on.
